Health Wildcatters Accelerator Program Health Wildcatters was founded in 2013 to address the need for a health innovation hub in the burgeoning Dallas/Fort Worth Metroplex healthcare industry. Since its inception the Health Wildcatters portfolio has grown to 140 startups who have raised over $350 million. Health Wildcatters provides a seed investment, in-kind perks and a vast network of mentors comprised of well over 200 individuals spanning the healthcare industry, professional services and many other verticals.
